title: "V0014 named_argument"
description: "Calls take positional arguments only (design §3.2 rule 13, §17.21); name: value exists only inside attribute arguments."
---

An error from the `parse` phase. `sakura explain V0014` prints this explanation offline.

Calls take positional arguments only (design §3.2 rule 13, §17.21); `name: value` exists only
inside attribute arguments. Pass the value positionally, or pass a record when the call needs
an options bag.

Wrong:

```sakura
clamp(x, lo: 0, hi: 10)
```

Fixed:

```sakura
clamp(x, 0, 10)
```
